FOR YOUR GEOGRAPHIC REVIEW

The places stay real.
The wonder comes next.

This draft uses extracted OpenStreetMap geometry. The diorama combines layered land edges, textured tropical canopies, water light and generated architectural symbols on the approved coordinates. Terrain, land cover and building details are illustrative; this is not measured terrain or an architectural reconstruction.

Regional coverage is cropped. The eastern edge of the land shape is Penang’s administrative boundary, not an island coastline.

Geography approved · 16 October 2026. The coastline, both bridge footprints, ferry alignment and representative pins are now fixed for illustration development. The detailed art treatment remains in progress.
